column1: # Every distinct historical patches/ tree crossed with every candidate
# subset, hashed under each git setting shown to move a digest over
# identical content. The control for a setting is the candidate closure
# hashed under that same setting, so a miss is the historical material
# rather than the setting; control_reproduces states that the control
# produced a digest under it. The four diff.algorithm values are absent
# because they produce one digest over this content and vary nothing.
